note: Adapted from Sjöstedt's 1911 original description (in German), original name Eutermes elegantulus n. sp., a preliminary-notice account; the soldier text and measurements are complete, while for the worker only the qualitative description of head, clypeus and mandibles survives, its subsequent measurements being interleaved with the account of a neighbouring species in the scanned text and therefore not used. The original uses a comma as the decimal separator, transcribed here as 2.85, 1.33 etc. Type locality Mukimbungu, Congo (collected by Laman).

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head pale red-yellow, nasus reddish brown; in lateral view the nasus forms a straight line with the vertex; in dorsal view the head is nearly circular and slightly narrowing anteriorly; the nasus is rather short, about 1/3 of the total head length measured from its lower base; the posterior margin of the antennal socket lies far behind the middle of the antenna (22:17). A very small nasute termite, soldier body length only 2.85 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Soldier: head pale red-yellow, nasus reddish brown; in lateral view the nasus forms a straight line with the vertex; in dorsal view the head is nearly circular, slightly narrowing anteriorly. The nasus is rather short, about 1/3 of the total head length measured from its lower base. The posterior margin of the antennal socket lies far behind the middle of the antenna (22:17). Antennae 12-segmented, slightly shorter than the head; the basal segment slightly shorter than the sum of the next two, segment 2 shorter than segment 3, segment 3 and segment 4 apparently equal, the segments towards the tip slightly larger and oval, the terminal segment oval and slightly smaller. Pronotum saddle-shaped, the anterior and posterior lobes almost equal in length, the anterior lobe without a median notch. Measurements: body length 2.85 mm; head length 1.33 mm; head width 0.70 mm; head height 0.4 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Worker: head pale yellow, with three white suture lines meeting in the middle, rounded-square, smooth, with only scattered hairs; no punctiform fontanelle in the middle, frons flat; clypeus rather small and oval, concolorous with the rest of the head; the first two mandibular teeth... (the original continues at the foot of the page, the scan breaks the line and the following text cannot be read reliably, so it is not cited).
